newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May refinery rate at 70.6 pct, up yr/yr-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan May refinery rate at 70.6 pct, up yr/yr-MITI.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japan's oil refineries stood at 70.6 percent in May, compared with 67.8 percent from the same month a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Tuesday.
Crude throughput amounted to 18.38 million kl in May, up 3.7 percent from a year earlier but down 12.9 percent from April, MITI said.
Japan's oil companies have a combined refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day as of the end of March.
